CheckTitle: Assessment role holds only read-only audit policies
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: Custom check (Identity & Cloud Posture Health Check). The role this scan ran through is read back from AWS and its attached and inline policies compared with the two it should hold: `SecurityAudit` and `ViewOnlyAccess`.
Risk: If the assessment role held more than read-only policies, the read-only promise would rest on the scanner's behaviour alone, not on AWS refusing any change.

Code.Other: IAM > Roles > the assessment role > Permissions: leave only SecurityAudit and ViewOnlyAccess attached, and no inline policy.

Recommendation.Text: Keep the assessment role to the two AWS-managed read-only audit policies.

Notes: Custom check shipped with this tool in prowler-checks/; mounted read-only into the Prowler container.
